serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
City is still in total chaos.
Shops are destroyed, trash bins burned, road signs are all bent in a grotesque way…
It’s like some cataclysm decimated the town.
In the distance I can still hear screams and sirens and my guess is that will be the case for a long time.
What has caused it?
Was the old man who grabbed my arm telling the truth?
And I don’t mean that he was lying to me. What I mean is that I doubt his perception.
I guess I will never know…
